name: Pocket Love
source:
Hero's love interest is in the higher grade class. This year he gets in the same class with his childhood friend and she piques his interest a lot as well. He is not confident in his abilities, but this year he wants to find his love. Hopefully by Christmas ... 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角喜欢的女孩在高年级班。今年，他与青梅竹马分到了同一个班级，也因此对她产生了浓厚兴趣。他对自己的能力没有信心，但今年想找到属于自己的爱情。希望能在圣诞节前实现……

（来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/08/vn-of-month-july-1997.html]vndreview[/url]）
